modelingNotes: ZB4BV013 is a head-only sub-assembly: white plain lens + Ø22 mm metal bezel. Catalog 'Heads only' table (PDF p.69) lists it under 'With plain lens / White', footnote 'For use with bodies comprising a light source with integral LED only.' The se.com product page (https://www.se.com/us/en/product/ZB4BV013/) describes it as 'Head for pilot light, Harmony XB4, metal, white, 22 mm, universal LED, plain lens' and lists no electrical connection or voltage.

Purely mechanical/optical scope: zero electrical terminals, no LED, no contacts. The integral LED light source and the screw-clamp supply terminals reside in the SEPARATELY ORDERED body sub-assembly (e.g., ZB4BVB1 24 V, ZB4BVG1 110-120 V, ZB4BVM1 230-240 V). Complete illuminated unit XB4BVB1 = ZB4BVB1 body + ZB4BV013 head (PDF p.68). None of those LED/terminal parts are imported into this head type.
Order identity kept as expected 'ZB4-BV013'; the manufacturer omits the presentation hyphen and spells it 'ZB4BV013' in the catalog rows and product URL. Job hint anticipated this hyphen difference.

No electrical bond is documented on the head. The panel-clamping fixing collar belongs to the body sub-assembly (catalog p.24 footnote: 'the body (fixing collar and contact)'), so any panel/metalwork bonding is outside this head's scope and is not asserted. No invented electrical pins or screw positions.

Exact suffix matters: plain lens = ZB4BV013 (this part); legend-insertion lens = ZB4BV013E; grooved lens = ZB4BV013S. Source 'With plain lens, White' matches the plain, non-legend, non-grooved white head. Color digit 1 = white.

White plain-lens mechanical head with zero documented electrical terminals; LED supply block is separate. The metal head/collar/panel attachment and bonding interface is not electrically established. No exhaustive absence of conductive interfaces or installed bond is claimed.
